title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: No change to the extension. Two of our own Logcat tests were launching a real adb process while the suite ran, and passed either way.

highlights.title: The suite stops launching adb
highlights.description: Two tests called the device switch directly, which starts the stream, which spawns adb. The result depended on whether adb was installed on the machine, and each run left the two second reconnection timer behind.

highlights.title: A guard against the next one
highlights.description: A new test replaces the adb entry point with one that refuses to run, and asserts that switching device, clearing, following a process and disposing all reach it zero times.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Nothing shipped in the extension itself. Every release from 1.42.38 onward was checked against a real Android project of 5088 files, with no difference in what the analyses answer.
